summaries.zh: DSH Director Toolkit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for 3D artists, technical designers, and creative coders. Paste a half-formed idea, a reference note, or a portfolio caption and get a compact direction pack for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D.
